name: Commit Message Helper
summary: Compose git commit messages with subject/body/footer — 72-char wrap, length checks, and co-author lines.
description: Write a clear commit subject, optional body, issue footer, and co-author trailers. Get a ready-to-paste message with 72-character body wrapping, subject length guidance (50/72), imperative-mood hints, and Co-authored-by formatting.

faqs.question: What is the ideal subject length?
faqs.answer: Aim for ≤ 50 characters so subjects stay readable in git log and GitHub. Hard limit guidance is 72 characters.

faqs.question: How is the body formatted?
faqs.answer: Paragraphs are preserved and long lines are wrapped at 72 characters — the convention for git commit bodies.

faqs.question: How do I add co-authors?
faqs.answer: Enter one person per line as Name <email@example.com>. Co-authored-by trailers are appended automatically.

faqs.question: Is this Conventional Commits?
faqs.answer: This helper focuses on general best practices (subject, body, footer). For type(scope): format, use the Conventional Commit Builder tool.
